## Required checks

- [ ] `README.md` was updated and matches the candidate artifact.
- [ ] `README.zh-CN.md` was updated with the same product facts.
- [ ] The English and Chinese READMEs link to each other and agree on version, downloads, requirements, pricing, and privacy behavior.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes user-visible changes and compatibility notes.
- [ ] Install, upgrade, uninstall, and quick-start instructions were tested.
- [ ] Privacy/data behavior and required permissions are documented.
- [ ] Exact release artifacts passed a clean-environment smoke test.
- [ ] Artifact filenames, architectures, versions, and SHA-256 checksums were recorded.
- [ ] Current files and release artifacts passed sensitive-data review.
- [ ] Any exposed credentials were revoked or rotated before cleanup.
- [ ] Product Hunt copy describes only verified, available functionality.
